# Paperclip agent roster - valid agent keys for review-gate attestations.
#
# Both Author-agent and Reviewer-agent in a paperclip-review block must appear
# here (case-insensitive) or the gate fails closed.
#
# Format (one entry per line):
#
#   bare-key                # full author + review capability (backward compatible)
#   key  author-only        # may author PRs but must never be Reviewer-agent
#
# The gate fails closed with a clear message when an author-only key appears
# as Reviewer-agent on any PR.
#
# Update this file when agents join or leave the fleet. The key must match the
# agent's short name as used in attestation blocks and Paperclip issue assignments.
#
# Bootstrap note: this file must exist on the base branch before review-gate.yml
# can validate attestations. The workflow reads it from the base branch, not the
# PR head, so a PR cannot add its own author key to bypass the gate.
ada
grace
linus
tim
ceo
cto
# coo authors Development-Lifecycle governance docs (CONTRIBUTING.md,
# docs/governance/). Author-agent only — the COO does not review code, so
# `coo` must never appear as Reviewer-agent on a code-bearing PR.
coo  author-only
